property.name: boundField
property.description-key: Placement anchor. Bind to any text column on the form.

property.name: apiBaseUrl
property.description-key: API base URL. Falls back to the sprk_BffApiBaseUrl environment variable.

property.name: tenantId
property.description-key: Azure AD tenant ID. Falls back to the sprk_TenantId environment variable.

property.name: clientAppId
property.description-key: Client application ID. Falls back to the sprk_MsalClientId environment variable.

property.name: bffAppId
property.description-key: API application ID. Falls back to the sprk_BffApiAppId environment variable.

property.name: showVersionFooter
property.description-key: Show the version footer at the bottom of the control.
